title.zh: AI照片搜索：SCM让Mac检索视频画面
title.en: AI Photo Search: SCM Indexes Mac Photos and Video

excerpt.zh: AI照片搜索工具SCM在Mac本地索引照片与视频画面，支持语义、OCR和对白检索；便利与隐私并存，但首次建库仍需下载模型并消耗本机资源。
excerpt.en: SCM brings AI photo search to macOS with local indexing for photos, video scenes, OCR, and dialogue, but setup and processing still rely on Mac resources.

text.en: AI Photo Search Comes to the Mac

text.zh: AI照片搜索项目SCM试图把个人媒体库变成可用自然语言查找的记忆库。这个开源macOS应用在本机运行视觉模型，为照片和视频建立索引；用户可以描述一个场景，而不必先记住文件名。项目作者在Hacker News发布后获得了较高关注，代码托管在GitHub。
text.en: SCM is an AI photo search project that turns a personal media library into a collection searchable with natural language. The open-source macOS app runs vision models locally and indexes photos and videos, so users can describe a scene instead of remembering a filename. The project drew strong attention after its Hacker News launch and is hosted on GitHub.

text.zh: 从整部视频定位到具体画面
SCM把功能分成几种互补模式：视觉搜索按整体含义匹配照片或视频，Scenes会切分视频并把结果定位到时间码，OCR检索图片中实际出现的文字，Dialogue则通过Whisper查找视频对白。文件名和短语也会参与部分排序，结果会显示匹配原因；查询还可以保存为带筛选范围的标签页。
text.en: SCM separates the task into complementary modes. Visual search matches photos or videos by meaning, Scenes segments videos and points to a timecode, OCR searches text that is visibly present, and Dialogue uses Whisper to find spoken words. Filenames and phrases can influence some rankings, while results show why they matched. Queries can also be saved as tabs with a defined scope.

text.zh: 它还提供一些面向个人资料库的维护功能：监视文件夹会自动导入，内容哈希可识别重命名后的重复文件，切换模型后会在后台重新嵌入。OCR支持英语及可选的其他语言，视频检索则允许在速度、磁盘占用和采样密度之间选择。可选的本地LLM还能依据已提取的对白、OCR和文件名证据回答问题，并提供引用。
text.en: The app also includes library-oriented maintenance features. Watched folders can import automatically, content hashes help detect duplicates after renames, and changing models triggers background re-embedding. OCR supports English plus optional additional languages, while video search offers sampling choices that trade speed and disk usage. An optional local LLM can answer questions from extracted dialogue, OCR, and filename evidence, with citations.

text.zh: 隐私优势不等于零成本
text.en: Local Privacy Still Has Practical Costs

text.zh: SCM的主要卖点是媒体不离开Mac：模型权重首次下载后，后续处理可离线完成，也不需要账号或云端上传。但这并不意味着体验没有门槛。默认视觉模型约需435MB，聊天模型还要约1.1GB或更多；首次建库、视频分段、Whisper转录和模型切换都可能占用明显的CPU、存储与时间。应用目前面向macOS，搜索质量也会受到模型选择、采样密度、OCR识别和对白转录准确度影响。对拥有大量视频的用户而言，真正值得观察的是本地索引的持续维护成本，以及在不同Mac配置上能否稳定提供足够快的检索反馈。
text.en: SCM’s central privacy claim is straightforward: media stays on the Mac. After model weights are downloaded, processing can continue offline without an account or cloud upload. That does not make the experience cost-free, however. The default vision model requires roughly 435 MB, chat models require about 1.1 GB or more, and initial indexing, video segmentation, Whisper transcription, and model changes can consume substantial CPU time, storage, and waiting time. The app is currently macOS-focused, and search quality depends on model choice, sampling density, OCR recognition, and transcription accuracy. For large video libraries, the open question is whether local indexing remains affordable to maintain while returning results quickly across different Mac configurations.
